about: Toolchain layers: Debian packages prebuilt on top of the streamed base rootfs (docs/DEBIAN.md "Toolchain layers"). scripts/debian/build-layers.sh builds them; src/debian/layers.ts applies them; `toolchain install ID` applies one.

c.title: C and C++
c.description: gcc, g++, make, cmake, gdb, pkg-config (build-essential)

python.title: Python 3
python.description: python3, pip, venv, dev headers, numpy, requests, yaml

go.title: Go
go.description: Debian's golang-go, with the standard library already compiled
prepare: # std compiled into the default build cache of the tab's user (HOME=/home/user), so
# go build in the tab only compiles the user's packages
env HOME=/home/user CGO_ENABLED=0 go build std
# go trims cache entries unused for 5 days, by mtime; the layer's times are the
# snapshot's, so a far-future last-trim time keeps the shipped entries
# cgo off by default (go env -w writes this file; go env -u CGO_ENABLED undoes it):
# the PATH's cc is tabcomputer's WASM compiler, and the cache above is built without cgo
go.check:
printf 'package main
import "fmt"
func main(){fmt.Println("hello")}
' > /tmp/tc-hello.go && cd /tmp && go run tc-hello.go
